Nearest day-out programs to Ironwood

This shelter doesn't list a day-out program yet, but these shelters nearby do:

  • Chequamegon Humane Association · Ashland, WI · about 35 miles · Day outings (up to 9 hrs) or overnight sleepovers (min 14 hrs) with a shelter animal
  • Northwoods Humane Society · Hayward, WI · about 70 miles · Take the same shelter dog to work, hiking or outings one day a week
  • Eau Claire Community Humane Association · Eau Claire, WI · about 130 miles · Take a shelter dog out for the day or a sleepover
